## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] Relevant macOS app build/tests (if applicable)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private vault data, generated build output, or local audit artifacts are included.
- [ ] Public/Pro boundaries, CGO-free builds, and MCP stdout discipline remain intact.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, and security implications are described above when relevant.
